title: [zbuild-test] Throwaway verification run for #2131 live status comment
goal: Produce a minimal valid pipeline run against issue #2137 to verify that PR #2136's live run-status comment mechanism fires correctly on both a local run and a CI daemon run.

steps.description: Verify the pipeline run completes end-to-end and a run-status comment is posted to issue #2137 on GitHub. No source files need to be created or modified — the run itself is the deliverable. Confirm the comment appears on the issue after the run.

notes: This is explicitly a throwaway issue (per issue body: 'Safe to close after'). It has no Definition of Done, no Acceptance Criteria, no 5-test trial, and no keeper migration — it exists solely to exercise the live run-status comment path introduced in PR #2136. The plan is intentionally a single no-op step: the value is the pipeline execution itself, not any code change. The scope manifest was not readable in prior attempts but the issue body makes clear no repository changes are intended or required. The prior plan checkpoint confirms this conclusion was reached before and should not be re-derived.
